svg.title: 06 | Ten-Model Selection and Input Sensitivity
svg.desc: Executed development-only selection among seven classical and three temporal GRU models on 990 source-matched model/window predictions from 99 Validation windows (60 NR and 39 TSR) of three independent ZuCo 2.0 people. All candidates share original identifiers and fixed class order. The predefined Validation ranking of Macro F1, Balanced Accuracy and candidate priority selects Gaze Random Forest with pooled Macro F1 0.6244, Balanced Accuracy 0.6231 and Accuracy 0.6465. Gated Fusion GRU follows at Macro F1 0.6107. Gaze forest Macro F1 varies between 0.3478 and 0.7654 across the three individual Validation people; their unweighted mean is 0.5813. On a separate fixed early-fusion logistic model, masking EEG features with Train-median imputation changed Macro F1 from 0.4518 to 0.5343; masking gaze changed it to 0.4907. This diagnostic is not causal modality attribution. Four reserved Test people contributing 160 windows were not scored; the selected development candidate does not yet have independent held-out performance.

g.text: 10 candidates | 990 matched predictions | 99 Validation windows | 3 independent people
Gaze forest person-level Macro F1 spans 0.3478–0.7654; pooled F1 is 0.6244.
Gaze Random Forest leads Validation; between-person variation and held-out Test performance remain open.
